I am an environmental economist, postdoctoral researcher, and lecturer at the Institute for Food and Resource Economics at the University of Bonn.

Using spatial econometrics and impact evaluation methodologies, my work aims to understand how environmental policies shape land-use dynamics and human well-being in critical ecosystems.

### Research Interests
* **Environmental & Development Economics:** Policy enforcement, tropical deforestation, and conservation incentives.
* **Health & Climate Co-benefits:** Quantifying the localized socio-economic and public health impacts of ecosystem protection.
* **Spatial Data Science:** Leveraging R and geospatial econometrics to evaluate policy outcomes.

*Feel free to explore my latest working papers in the [Research](research.qmd) tab or reach out via email for potential collaborations!*
